writer.continuity_review.truncated: Some findings were trimmed for display.
writer.continuity_review.waiver_reason_h: Recorded with the exemption so you remember the decision.
writer.continuity_studio.assessment_evid: Why you judged it this way (quote or note); shown in the review report.
writer.continuity_studio.assessment_revi: The chapter version the requirement assessments were made against. When it differs from the chapter's current version, the review warns that the assessments are stale.
writer.continuity_studio.assessment_stat: Deviated produces a chapter_plan_deviation warning in the review.
writer.continuity_studio.assessments_hin: Your verdict on each hard requirement from this chapter's plan. Feeds the continuity review only; never sent to the AI.
writer.continuity_studio.due_chapter_hin: The latest chapter it should resolve by. Still open past this chapter triggers an overdue warning; without it the item is not tracked for overdue.
writer.continuity_studio.event_chapter_h: The chapter where the event appears.
writer.continuity_studio.event_label_hin: Names the event so review findings can point at it.
writer.continuity_studio.evidence_hint: Supporting text for the review report. Never sent to the AI.
writer.continuity_studio.fact_detail_hin: Additional detail injected with the fact into the context of later chapters.
writer.continuity_studio.fact_predicate_: What holds true about the subject; forms the fact label together with the subject.
writer.continuity_studio.fact_source_cha: The chapter where this fact is established. Earlier chapters never see it, so it cannot leak early.
writer.continuity_studio.fact_subject_hi: Who or what the fact is about; forms the fact label together with the predicate.
writer.continuity_studio.fact_used_in_hi: Chapters that use this fact. The review reports it when one comes before the establishing chapter.
writer.continuity_studio.foreshadowing_d: The setup itself. While open and already planted it is injected into the AI context as a reminder to pay it off.
writer.continuity_studio.foreshadowing_r: Status and resolving chapter disagree: a resolved item needs a resolving chapter, and only resolved items may have one. The continuity review reports this as an error.
writer.continuity_studio.foreshadowing_s: Only open items are injected into the AI context. Resolved requires a resolving chapter; abandoned means you gave it up.
writer.continuity_studio.life_status_hin: Unknown keeps this entry out of the life checks. Dead followed by alive without an explanation is reported as a resurrection.
writer.continuity_studio.mark_assessed: Mark as checked against current version
writer.continuity_studio.planted_chapter: Where the setup is planted; determines from which chapter on the AI sees it.
writer.continuity_studio.resolved_chapte: Where the setup pays off. Required when the status is resolved.
writer.continuity_studio.sequence_hint: Position within the chapter. The timeline, chapter, and order combination must be unique.
writer.continuity_studio.state_chapter_h: The chapter where this observation is made.
writer.continuity_studio.state_character: The observed character, from the story bible's cast.
writer.continuity_studio.state_location_: Where the character is at this point. Conflicting locations in the same slot are reported by the review.
writer.continuity_studio.story_time_hint: A numeric point on the in-story clock (any unit, kept consistent). A later event with an earlier story time is reported as a timeline regression.
writer.continuity_studio.summary_chapter: The chapter this summary describes. Each chapter can have at most one summary.
writer.continuity_studio.summary_text_hi: Injected into the AI context when writing later chapters (only earlier chapters' summaries are included).
writer.continuity_studio.tabs.chapter_su: Per-chapter summaries. When writing a later chapter, earlier summaries are injected into the AI context; requirement assessments feed the continuity review.
writer.continuity_studio.tabs.character_: Observed character location and life status per chapter. Never injected into the AI context; the continuity review uses them to detect conflicts.
writer.continuity_studio.tabs.facts_hint: Established story facts. From their source chapter onward they are injected into the AI context; the continuity review checks they are not used earlier.
writer.continuity_studio.tabs.foreshadow: Planted setups and their payoff. Open items are injected into the AI context from their planted chapter onward, and the review flags overdue or inconsistent ones.
writer.continuity_studio.tabs.timeline_e: In-story chronology. Never injected into the AI context; the continuity review uses it to detect time regressions.
writer.continuity_studio.timeline_id_hin: Groups events into a timeline (default "main"). Events on different timelines are never compared for order.
writer.continuity_studio.timeline_slot_c: Another event uses the same timeline, chapter, and order; saving will fail until one of them changes.
writer.continuity_studio.transition_expl: Explains a life-status reversal (revival, faked death). When filled in, the reversal is not reported.
